class.name: Ed25519
class.brief_description: RFC 8032 Ed25519 digital signatures and a legacy X25519 authenticated public-key encryption helper, backed by Monocypher.
class.description: Provides Ed25519 (RFC 8032, SHA-512) signing and verification, interoperable with libsodium, WebCrypto and @noble/ed25519. Also exposes a legacy [method encrypt]/[method decrypt] pair performing Ed25519-to-X25519 key conversion plus XChaCha20-Poly1305 authenticated public-key encryption; new code should prefer a [X25519] handshake followed by [Monocypher] AEAD instead. All cryptographic operations are powered by the vendored Monocypher library. Keys are 32-byte [PackedByteArray]s and signatures are 64 bytes.

method.name: sign
method.description: Signs [param message] with the RFC 8032 Ed25519 key whose 32-byte seed is [param private_key]. The public key is derived from the seed internally and bound to it (this prevents a key-extraction attack where signing the same seed with a mismatched public key leaks the private scalar). [param public_key] is optional: pass an empty [PackedByteArray] to have it derived, or pass the 32-byte public key to have it checked - a mismatch causes an error and an empty signature (fail-fast on caller bugs). Returns a 64-byte [PackedByteArray] signature, or an empty [PackedByteArray] (with an error) on a bad [param private_key] size, a mismatched [param public_key], or any other error.

method.name: verify
method.description: Verifies a 64-byte Ed25519 [param signature] against [param message] using [param public_key]. Returns [code]true[/code] if valid, [code]false[/code] otherwise (including size mismatches).

method.name: encrypt
method.description: [b]Deprecated legacy helper.[/b] Encrypts [param message] for the owner of [param their_public_key] using [param my_private_key] (32-byte Ed25519 seed). Internally derives an X25519 scalar from the seed (SHA-512, RFC 8032 / libsodium compatible), converts the public keys to Curve25519, performs Diffie-Hellman, and encrypts with XChaCha20-Poly1305. Returns [code]nonce (24 bytes) + MAC (16 bytes) + ciphertext[/code], or an empty array on invalid key sizes or CSPRNG failure. Prefer a [X25519] handshake + [Monocypher] AEAD for new code.

method.name: decrypt
method.description: [b]Deprecated legacy helper.[/b] Decrypts [param encrypted_data] (as produced by [method encrypt]) from the owner of [param their_public_key] using [param my_private_key]. Verifies the MAC before returning plaintext. Returns the decrypted [PackedByteArray], or an empty array if authentication fails or inputs are invalid.
